messages.subject: secr 2.9.4
parts:
secr 2.9.4 is now available with binaries on CRAN. This version fixes a few bugs, tweaks various functions and extends the capability for modelling non-Euclidean distances (static barriers to movement and the function nedist - see [url]http://www.otago.ac.nz/density/pdfs/secr-noneuclidean.pdf[/url]) . See [url]http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/secr/index.html[/url] for more.
Murray
